clips.title: The story
paras: Bloodied Insignias are tragic remnants of the fallen defenders of Lordaeron, scattered among the kingdom's blighted ruins. Bearing the old crests of the Alliance, these battered badges represent soldiers whose families fled south to Stormwind during the Third War.

When Prince Arthas returned to scour Lordaeron with the Scourge, its grand military was overwhelmed and butchered. Countless soldiers perished defending the Capital City and the surrounding lands, leaving behind few physical traces beyond rusted armor and bloodstained brass. These old Alliance insignias belonged to the men and women who stood their ground against the undead onslaught. Trampled into the soil and rubble of the ruins, each medal is an artifact of the kingdom's final, desperate stand.

Many survivors of Lordaeron fled south across the sea, settling as refugees in Stormwind City. Decades of alliance and kinship tie the two human realms together, leaving many in the south yearning for closure concerning their missing loved ones. General Marcus Jonathan, commander of the Stormwind city guard, takes custody of these bloodied insignias so that the memory of the northern defenders is preserved and their surviving families may finally learn their fate.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The old Alliance insignia appears to have belonged to a soldier of Lordaeron. These ruins are likely filled with similar medals that living relatives would be grateful to have returned to them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look as if you're carrying a heavy burden, friend. What is it?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your instincts to bring these to me were not unfounded. When Lordaeron fell to the Scourge, many people fled to take refuge here in Stormwind. There are likely few who remain to claim these insignias themselves.
Your duty to Stormwind is commended, friend. I'll begin distributing these tokens to next of kin right away.
